scope: Read-only review of both actual native PCBs, all board and footprint Edge.Cuts, drilled pads, the display slot/ZIF path, M1 mating and the battery holder. This snapshot is not a manufacturing release, a completed whole-device interface audit or an ERC/DRC waiver. Concurrent service-button and LED corrections are not represented by these native board hashes.

native_observations.method: KiCad pcbnew.LoadBoard read-only; GetDrawings plus every footprint GraphicalItems for Edge.Cuts; all pad attributes, positions and drill dimensions inspected. No PCB saved and no generator run.

mounting_axes.distance_scope: Direct native pad-bounding-box XY check only; not exact component bodies, silkscreen glyphs, solder heights or final enclosure tolerance proof. Root owns the separate silkscreen review.

LESHY2-UI-R2.meaning: USB shell tabs are soldered PTH; S3 pad41 has plated thermal vias, not lead tails. M1 and side-button guide holes are unplated plastic-post locations. No M1 electrical contact is through-hole.

LESHY2-RF-R2.meaning: USB shell tabs, Cap socket J10 and encoder SW3 include real PTH terminals; L32 and U3 drilled electrical pads are vias. BT1 has no drill despite the holder locating features.

display.mouth_direction: board -Y, toward slot; opposite the solder-contact row in Hirose section Q
display.mating_numbering: panel tail n -> manufacturer FH34 contact 51-n; all 50 entries explicit in display-mount.json
display.coordinate_note: H6 moves the complete H1 display/FPC/PSA construction by +8.50 mm in Y. H1 display-mount coordinates are historical source positions, not direct native coordinates. Relative slot/mouth geometry is unchanged.

native_evidence.physical_stack_transform: With both antenna edges at the top, turning the rear PCB so its B.Cu faces UI B.Cu reverses X: x_world=80-x_RF, y_world=y_RF. This is also the explicit rear-outer/rf-inner transform in assembly-coordinate-model.json.
native_evidence.polarization_observation: Primary mounting-side patterns put the plug polarization mark at lower left and socket mark at upper left. KiCad local pad1 follows these corners. Merely centring the current B0/B0 footprints would still place the socket opposite the wrong contact end after physical X reflection.
native_evidence.frame_ambiguity: H6 build_target_index mixes world_bbox seeds with frame labels, so existing same-coordinate native anchors are not independent proof of physical registration. Do not declare a mating pass until a single native-to-assembly transform and both keyed contact arrays are checked.

H6-MECH-M1-NATIVE-MATING.correction_needed: Resolve the H6 frame explicitly, align the exact physical body axes and polarization, verify every M1 mating contact/net, then collision-check, reroute and repeat native DRC. Conditional geometry candidate, not an adopted placement: preserve UI B0/[42.5,122.25] and use RF B180/[37.5,122.25]. Different SMT tail-row offsets on P/S are not errors if their physical mating axes agree.

native_evidence.rf_edge_geometry: Only the outer 80x150 rounded rectangle; no internal/edge cutout exists in board or footprint items.
native_evidence.footprint_geometry: Six SMD lands and rectangular F.Fab/F.CrtYd geometry; no Edge.Cuts.

primary.document: Rev 1.06, 2024-09-12, Recommended PCB Layout Top View
primary.geometry: Mid-mount body requires the illustrated PCB cutout, 6.80-mm basic width and 11.50-mm basic depth with asymmetric 3.35/3.45 sides and R0.30 side reliefs. PCB tolerance is +/-0.05 mm. The illustrated profile cannot be replaced by a guessed F.Fab rectangle.

H6-MECH-SJ43504-MISSING-CUTOUT.correction_needed: Materialize the exact manufacturer cutout and transform it with the accepted connector pose. Cutout-to-edge closure, drill/router capability, all-layer copper clearance, neighbouring footprints and opposite-face body intrusion must be checked. Repeat native DRC after the board outline changes.

primary.document: Keystone K75 2025 catalogue, DUAL CELL / SURFACE MOUNT / Pad Layout
primary.geometry: The holder side view includes protruding 3.7-mm-diameter retaining feet and a 1.57-mm-diameter, 1.57-mm-long locator. The pad layout specifies two diameter3.5-mm holes on opposite corners, a diameter2.4-mm locator hole and two diameter3.2-mm body-mount holes. Retaining-feature centre pitch is55.2mm longitudinal and35.0mm transverse.

H6-MECH-1048P-LOCATOR-HOLES.correction_needed: Add the source-backed non-electrical hole geometry and register the asymmetric locator to the exact holder orientation. Verify which two3.2-mm body-mount holes are optional fastener clearances instead of treating them as required electrical vias. Obtain the exact part drawing/CAD to bind the small locator axis before manufacture, then clear every layer and inner-face component. Do not clip the moulded features or silently increase the holder Z to bypass missing holes.

orientation_candidate_not_release_data.axis_registration_status: Must be independently tied to the accepted asymmetric holder orientation; not yet an adopted drill placement.

primary.section: DUAL CELL / SURFACE MOUNT / Pad Layout

H6-MECH-1048P-SMT-LAND-SIZE.correction_needed: Rebuild the holder's exact recommended land pattern, not just enlarge around the current pad centres blindly. Check outer-span datum, cell axes/polarity, M1 locator clearance, full copper/net changes and native DRC. The present 4x6 lands do not meet the published7.3x6.4 minimum.

H6-MECH-DISPLAY-FPC-FOLD-ENVELOPE.native_evidence: The actual Edge.Cuts slot and J1 B.Cu/0-degree mouth direction are consistent with the no-twist upper-edge fold and inverse50-contact numbering. This establishes the planar path and orientation, not a proven folded 3D envelope.

primary.section: Mechanical drawing of exact configured panel and FPC
primary.geometry: Tail length30.16+/-0.50mm, width25.50+/-0.15mm, stiffener0.30mm; the drawing does not alone close bend radius or component-bearing folded stack height.

primary.document: EDC-159714-50-08, section Q and mounting-side pattern

H6-MECH-DISPLAY-FPC-FOLD-ENVELOPE.correction_needed: Retain the explicit unclosed construction gates: actual neutral-axis route at most24.66mm, at least5mm relaxed reserve versus29.66mm minimum tail, folded component stack at most0.714mm with selected stock PSA, actual clearance at least0.20mm and a supplier/lot-supported bend radius. Neither a flat drawing nor dual-contact ZIF proves that the assembled flex can be creased, stretched or compressed. Validate before irreversible panel bonding; source-backed feasibility remains required before a manufacturing release.

H6-MECH-OPPOSING-BODY-AND-TAIL-Z.native_evidence: Both native boards use B.Cu as inner face with an intended11mm gap. The existing placement cross-face reserves account for pad/drill XY boxes, not fully tolerance-bounded lead protrusion, solder fillets, moulded posts, counterpart bodies or inserted Cap pins. After the missing holder holes and M1 pose are corrected, these quantities change materially.
H6-MECH-OPPOSING-BODY-AND-TAIL-Z.correction_needed: Keep H6.0.7 assembled-body verification open. Bind the exact board-to-world transform, populated body and through-hole tail maximums and actual hole/stop tolerances; rerun opposing-body and cable/FPC clearance after these interface corrections. Current2D DRC cannot certify this volume.

H6-MECH-SMA-FINISHED-THICKNESS-FIT.correction_needed: Preserve the existing supplier-confirmation gate in h6-r2-mechanical-stack.json.
